Ahmed Fatouh.note: What separates Fatouh is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Fatouh waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. At another point, he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Ahmed Fatouh.noteZh: 观察Ahmed Fatouh时，可以先看从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个比赛细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Emam Ashour.note: What separates Ashour is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Ashour arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. At another point, he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Emam Ashour.noteZh: 观察Emam Ashour时，可以先看等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个比赛细节是他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Haissem Hassan.note: Hassan's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. At another point in the move, he plays forward toward an available runner when the opening appears.
Haissem Hassan.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Haissem Hassan踢法的关键。先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。到了另一个比赛环节，他会线路出现时向前送给可接应的跑动者。

Hamdy Fathy.note: For Fathy, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. A separate point is how he moves the ball to the next available teammate without holding it.
Hamdy Fathy.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Hamdy Fathy踢法的关键。先看他如何守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会不拖延持球，把球交给下一名可接应的队友。

Hamza Abdelkarim.note: Abdelkarim stands out for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. A different detail is how Abdelkarim angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Hamza Abdelkarim.noteZh: Hamza Abdelkarim的比赛建立在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动之上。首先看他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。另一个方面是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Hossam Abdelmaguid.note: Watch Abdelmaguid for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. The clearest example is how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. A separate clue is how Abdelmaguid moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Hossam Abdelmaguid.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Hossam Abdelmaguid踢法的关键。先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Ibrahim Adel.note: The key to Adel is explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. In another phase, Adel shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ibrahim Adel.noteZh: 看Ibrahim Adel的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Karim Hafez.note: Hafez stands out for delivering the ball without needing much space. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. A different question is whether he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Karim Hafez.noteZh: 很小空间里也能送出传中的能力是理解Karim Hafez踢法的关键。先看他如何在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。另一个问题是，Karim Hafez是否会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Mahdy Soliman.note: The key to Soliman is command of the crowded space around goal. He leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders. One more thing to notice is how Soliman sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Mahdy Soliman.noteZh: 看El Mahdy Soliman的作用，关键是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Mahmoud Saber.note: What separates Saber is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Saber angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Away from that action, he takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Mahmoud Saber.noteZh: 带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑构成Mahmoud Saber踢法的核心。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。除此之外，值得留意他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Marawan Attia.note: Watch Attia for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. The clearest example is how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. In a different phase, Attia holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Marawan Attia.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Marwan Attia踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mohamed Abdelmoneim.summary: Mohamed Abdelmoneim is an Egypt centre-back from OGC Nice who gives the national team front-foot defending, aerial power, and aggressive stepping.
Mohamed Abdelmoneim.note: Abdelmonem's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Watch how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Another detail is how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Mohamed Abdelmoneim.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢是理解Mohamed Abdelmonem踢法的关键。先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。到了另一个比赛环节，他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Mohamed Alaa.note: For Alaa, the foundation is protecting the centre before the shooter reveals the finish. Look first at how he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot. For a wider picture, notice whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Mohamed Alaa.noteZh: 最能体现Mohamed Alaa特点的是射手暴露射门方向前先守住球门中央。这一点直接体现在他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。接着可以问，他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Mohamed El Shenawy.note: Watch El Shenawy for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. The clearest example is how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. A separate clue is how El Shenawy keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required.
Mohamed El Shenawy.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友是理解Mohamed El Shenawy踢法的关键。先看他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。

Mohamed Hany.note: Watch Hany for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. In a different phase, Hany gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Mohamed Hany.noteZh: 看Mohamed Hany的作用，关键是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Mohamed Salah.note: The key to Salah is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover. One more thing to notice is how Salah moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Mohamed Salah.noteZh: 防线重组前制造干净射门是理解Mohamed Salah踢法的关键。先看他如何保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。到了另一个比赛环节，他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Mohanad Lashin.summary: Mohanad Lashin is an Egypt defensive midfielder from Pyramids FC who gives the national team central coverage, ball winning, and simple progression.
Mohanad Lashin.note: What separates Lasheen is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Lasheen waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Away from that action, he takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Mohanad Lashin.noteZh: 观察Mohanad Lasheen时，可以先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个比赛细节是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Mostafa Shoubir.summary: Mostafa Shoubir is an Egypt goalkeeper from Al Ahly who gives the national team reaction saves, line command, and close-range stops.
Mostafa Shoubir.note: The key to Shobeir is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. One more thing to notice is how Shobeir keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Mostafa Shoubir.noteZh: 看Mostafa Shobeir的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Mostafa Zico.note: Ziko's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Watch how he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover. Separately, he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Mostafa Zico.noteZh: 理解Mostafa Ziko，要先看防线重组前制造干净射门。他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Nabil Donga.note: For Emad, the foundation is reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. Look first at how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. Separately, look at how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Nabil Donga.noteZh: 观察Nabil Emad时，可以先看对抗后球权松动时的第一反应。他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。另一个比赛细节是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Omar Marmoush.note: Marmoush stands out for making defenders respect the shot from outside the box. He uses a clean first touch to open a shooting lane from distance. Marmoush also changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Omar Marmoush.noteZh: 理解Omar Marmoush，要先看让防守者必须提防禁区外远射。他会用干净的第一脚触球打开远射线路。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Ramy Rabia.note: Rabia stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself. Rabia also slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Ramy Rabia.noteZh: Ramy Rabia最鲜明的特点是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。一个直接线索是他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。另一个独立细节是他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Tarek Alaa.summary: Tarek Alaa is an Egypt right-back from ZED FC who gives the national team right-side defending, overlap energy, and recovery runs.
Tarek Alaa.note: Alaa's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Away from that moment, he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Tarek Alaa.noteZh: Tarek Alaa的比赛建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢之上。首先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个方面是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Trezeguet.note: For Trézéguet, the foundation is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Look first at how he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover. Beyond the first action, he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Trezeguet.noteZh: 防线重组前制造干净射门是理解Trézéguet踢法的关键。先看他如何保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。到了另一个比赛环节，他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Yasser Ibrahim.note: What separates Ibrahim is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. Ibrahim protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. Away from that action, he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Yasser Ibrahim.noteZh: Yasser Ibrahim的比赛建立在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择之上。首先看他如何先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Zizo.note: Zizo stands out for delivering the ball without needing much space. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. In a separate phase, Zizo varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Zizo.noteZh: Zizo最鲜明的特点是很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。一个直接线索是他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。另一个独立细节是他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。
